prompt.en: In what year was O Canada proclaimed the national anthem?
prompt.fr: En quelle année Ô Canada a-t-il été proclamé hymne national?

explanation.en: O Canada became the official national anthem in 1980, a hundred years after it was first sung.
explanation.fr: Ô Canada est devenu l'hymne national officiel en 1980, cent ans après avoir été chanté pour la première fois.

source.quote: O Canada was proclaimed as the national anthem in 1980. It was first sung in Québec City in 1880.

verification.evidence: O Canada was proclaimed as the national anthem in 1980.
